output.title: Three-Bedroom House with Private Garden and Parking in Mamer
output.description:
Situated in the suburban commune of Mamer, this three-bedroom house offers 130 square meters of living space within a quiet residential area characterized by well-maintained row houses from the 1980s. The property features a neutral facade and a small front yard enhancing its welcoming aspect.

Inside, the living room benefits from patio doors that open toward the private rear garden, providing natural daylight and views of the outdoors. The space presents a lived-in ambiance and is primed for modernization to suit contemporary tastes. A dedicated alcove in the living area currently accommodates a tube television.

The garden is modest yet well-kept, bordered by a wood fence that ensures privacy. A lawn area with a small shed offers practical storage options and outdoor usability. Additional conveniences include designated parking and a cellar located within the building’s basement for separate storage needs.

Mamer is known for its residential character and access to educational institutions such as the European School Luxembourg II and various lycées. Good connections to motorways and rail enhance accessibility toward Luxembourg City and the surrounding region. This property presents an opportunity to reside within a calm neighborhood that benefits from suburban amenities and transport links.

highlights.text: Private rear garden with lawn and shed
